title: Global NVM Vendor Patent Maps
intro: Systematic tracking of core patent families, first-principles claims, foundry process compatibility, and commercial product lineage for leading NVM IP vendors. Every patent trace links back to authoritative patent gazettes, excluding unverified marketing claims.

vendors.name: eMemory Technology Inc.
vendors.founders: Dr. Charles Ching-Hsiang Hsu, Fang-Cheng Lu, and the R&D team
vendors.businessModel: Pure-Play Logic-Based Embedded Non-Volatile Memory IP Licensing & Design Services (0-Mask Logic NVM IP)

patentStats.keyJurisdictions: United States (USPTO), Taiwan (TIPO), China (CNIPA), Europe (EPO), Japan (JPO)
patentStats.foundryCoverage: TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, SMIC, Vanguard (VIS), Tower Semiconductor
patentStats.waferShipment: Over 100 Billion Cumulative Commercial Silicon Shipments

vendors.strategy: The foundational philosophy of eMemory's patent portfolio is 'Zero Mask Adder' and '100% Standard CMOS Logic Process Compatibility'. Unlike conventional eFlash architectures that demand 3 to 8 additional specialized polysilicon masks or high-temperature thermal steps, eMemory's patent topology builds entirely upon native gate dielectrics, polysilicon gates, and well diffusion regions available in standard CMOS logic. Its patent map unfolds across two foundational vectors: the charge-storage trajectory (NeoBit floating-gate OTP → NeoEE capacitive-coupling MTP → NeoMTP erase-gate MTP) and the dielectric-physics trajectory (NeoFuse gate-oxide antifuse OTP → NeoPUF quantum-tunneling hardware security root of trust), spanning legacy sub-micron nodes down to 2nm GAA nanosheet architectures.

families.name: NeoBit® Floating-Gate OTP Patent Family
families.tagline: Standard CMOS Series Dual-PMOS · Channel Hot Electron Injection (CHEI) · 0-Mask Adder
families.cellTopology: 2-PMOS (Select Transistor and Floating-Gate Transistor in Series)
families.physicalMechanism: Drain band-to-band tunneling induces hot holes, impact-generating secondary hot electrons injected into the p+ floating gate (CHEI); read senses channel conduction current
families.processNode: 0.5µm down to 0.11µm Standard Logic & High-Voltage BCD Processes
families.summary: The flagship breakthrough establishing eMemory's commercial leadership. By employing series-connected PMOS transistors in standard logic without a dedicated control gate, lateral fields generate secondary electrons injected into the floating gate, eliminating the prohibitive cost of double-poly control gates and creating the industry's first true zero-mask logic OTP.

patents.title: Method of programming a series PMOS embedded EPROM cell
patents.coreProblem: Conventional EPROM/OTP cells require dedicated control gates and additional polysilicon layers for capacitive coupling, escalating logic process wafer costs. How can efficient electron injection be achieved on standard PMOS devices lacking a control gate?
patents.mechanism: Specifies a pair of series-connected p-channel MOS transistors: a first PMOS serving as a select transistor, and a second PMOS having an isolated floating gate. Applying positive 3–8V bias between Source Line (SL) and N-Well while biasing the drain negatively induces drain band-to-band tunneling holes. Secondary hot electrons generated by impact ionization are accelerated by vertical oxide fields across the 3.15 eV barrier into the floating gate.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 specifies a series PMOS structure devoid of a control gate, biasing the source and N-well to a common positive potential while applying negative drain bias to inject secondary avalanche electrons into the floating gate.
patents.productLink: The founding patent behind NeoBit mass production, widely deployed in PMICs, audio DAC calibration, and LCD driver ICs.

patents.title: Programmed logic non-volatile memory cell with retained charges
patents.coreProblem: Written floating-gate cells must ensure robust charge retention under extreme high-temperature environments while providing high signal-to-noise margins for sense amplifiers.
patents.mechanism: Programmed floating gates retain a stable negative charge packet. In PMOS physics, negative gate charge shifts the threshold voltage negatively, driving the storage PMOS into a conductive state under read bias, while unprogrammed cells remain cut off. Arrhenius extrapolations demonstrate data retention exceeding 10 years at 125°C.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 defines an unprogrammed cell in a non-conductive state and a programmed cell retaining negative charges on the floating gate to establish a low-resistance conduction path, using channel current level to represent logical data.
patents.productLink: The core reference patent for NeoBit data retention specifications and qualification standards.

patents.title: Non-volatile memory cell fabricated using standard logic CMOS process
patents.coreProblem: How to establish that an NVM cell design requires zero process modifications and shares peripheral fabrication layers identically?
patents.mechanism: The storage PMOS gate oxide thickness, polysilicon doping, and source/drain diffusion junctions directly reuse the peripheral 3.3V or 5V I/O transistor layers available on the foundry logic wafer, without extra masks or thermal cycles.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 requires the NVM storage cell to share gate dielectric thickness and electrical properties with peripheral I/O devices, formulating the legal boundary of 0-mask logic integration.
patents.productLink: Legal foundation protecting NeoBit's true zero-mask-adder foundry integration contract.

families.name: NeoFuse® Gate-Oxide Antifuse OTP Patent Family
families.tagline: Core Ultra-Thin Gate Oxide Soft Breakdown · Direct Tunneling · 3T Leakage Suppression
families.cellTopology: 3T (Select Transistor SEL + Regulating Transistor REG + Antifuse Element AF)
families.physicalMechanism: High electric field stress generates localized defects within ultra-thin gate oxides, enabling direct tunneling conduction filaments; read senses gate leakage current (I_GATE)
families.summary: The technological cornerstone enabling eMemory to penetrate deep sub-micron advanced nodes and hardware security. Replacing destructive polysilicon eFuses, NeoFuse exploits controlled gate oxide breakdown and direct tunneling in sub-2nm dielectrics, utilizing a proprietary 3T architecture to suppress half-select disturb and GIDL leakage, scaling seamlessly to 2nm GAA nanosheets.

patents.title: Antifuse memory cell and operating method thereof
patents.coreProblem: In sub-2nm core gate oxide nodes, traditional antifuses suffer from read disturb and accidental half-select breakdown during array programming.
patents.mechanism: Applies controlled programming pulses across the antifuse gate to trigger localized dielectric soft breakdown. During read, an interrogation voltage below 1.2V senses gate leakage (I_GATE). Unprogrammed gates leak <1pA, while programmed gates conduct several µA, opening an expansive sensing window.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 specifies reading the antifuse below its breakdown threshold voltage and sensing gate leakage current rather than channel conduction to determine programmed states.
patents.productLink: Standard IP across tier-1 foundry PDKs (28nm HPC+, 22ULL, 16FFC, N6/N5).

patents.title: Three-transistor antifuse memory cell with leakage current suppression
patents.coreProblem: In high-density arrays, a ruptured antifuse injects parasitic sneak leakage into shared bitlines, degrading sensing margins of unprogrammed cells and inflating standby power.
patents.mechanism: Introduces a three-transistor (3T) topology: select transistor (SEL) and regulating transistor (REG) connected in series with the antifuse (AF). The REG transistor buffers high programming voltage away from SEL and pinches off GIDL during standby, boosting array sensing SNR by over 30dB.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 covers a 3T cell comprising series-connected SEL, REG, and AF devices, where the REG gate is driven by a dedicated dynamic impedance control line.
patents.productLink: The core architecture of NeoFuse high-density arrays with ultra-low standby leakage.

patents.title: FinFET antifuse memory device and operation method
patents.coreProblem: 3D FinFET structures have sharp fin corners that concentrate electric fields, leading to uncontrolled dielectric damage and metal splatter that short adjacent fins.
patents.mechanism: Tailors the antifuse cell for 3D fin geometry, utilizing high-k metal gates (HKMG) wrapped around the fin to induce self-limiting dielectric breakdown along vertical fin sidewalls, constraining write current under 50µA.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 claims an antifuse structure wrapped across 3D semiconductor fins, defining sidewall breakdown paths and fin bias combinations.
patents.productLink: Key patent supporting NeoFuse qualification in 16nm, 12nm, 7nm, and 5nm FinFET processes.

patents.title: Antifuse memory cell having multi-thickness gate dielectric and operation thereof
patents.coreProblem: In sub-3nm Gate-All-Around (GAA) nanosheets operating below 0.7V, high breakdown voltages risk destructive punch-through across ultrathin sheets.
patents.mechanism: Integrates multi-thickness stepped dielectrics within a single cell, concentrating high fields across a localized breakdown window while protecting channel regions with thicker oxide liners.
patents.claimFocus: Discloses GAA nanosheet antifuse structures integrating stepped dielectric layers and dynamic potential isolation.
patents.productLink: NeoFuse patent deployment targeting N3P and N2 advanced foundry nodes.

families.name: NeoEE® Single-Poly MTP Patent Family
families.tagline: Pure Single-Poly · Symmetrical FN/FN Tunneling · Zero Static Power · 1K–10K Cycles
families.cellTopology: MOS Capacitive Coupler (C) + Tunneling Junction (T) + Read MOS (R) Sharing Floating Gate
families.physicalMechanism: Both program and erase utilize Fowler-Nordheim (FN) quantum tunneling; MOS capacitor couples voltage to modulate floating-gate potential
families.processNode: 0.35µm down to 0.11µm Standard Logic & Analog BCD Processes
families.summary: Designed for applications requiring field rewritability (sensor trimming, RFID UID updates, MCU calibration) without the cost of double-poly eFlash. Achieves bidirectional FN tunneling with programming currents under 1nA/bit, eliminating large on-chip charge pumps and serving ultra-low-power IoT applications.

patents.title: Single-poly electrically erasable programmable read only memory cell with capacitive coupling
patents.coreProblem: Conventional EEPROMs rely on double-poly control gates to provide adequate capacitive coupling, which is incompatible with pure logic CMOS.
patents.mechanism: Employs an N-well or MOS capacitor as a dedicated coupling capacitor (C node) overlapping the single-poly floating gate to achieve high coupling ratios (>0.7), while separating tunneling (T node) and read channel (R node) functions.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 specifies a single continuous polysilicon floating gate spanning capacitive coupling, tunneling, and sensing channel regions.
patents.productLink: Foundational architecture behind NeoEE zero-mask logic EEPROM IP.

patents.title: Method of operating single poly non-volatile memory cell using FN tunneling for both program and erase
patents.coreProblem: Channel hot electron injection draws milliamperes of current, making on-chip charge pumps prohibitively large for passive RFID tags and coin-cell devices.
patents.mechanism: Programs by applying positive bias to C while grounding T, injecting electrons into the floating gate via FN tunneling. Erases by reversing the polarity, drawing electrons out via FN tunneling. Entire cycle operates purely via capacitive displacement currents (<1nA).
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 claims bidirectional FN quantum tunneling for both program and erase combined with low-field channel resistance sensing.
patents.productLink: NeoEE ultra-low-power IoT and RFID tag applications.

families.name: NeoMTP® High-Density MTP Patent Family
families.tagline: Dedicated Erase Gate (EG) · Channel Hot Electron Writing · Edge FN Erasing · 25–40 F²
families.cellTopology: PMOS Floating Gate + Lateral Dedicated Erase Gate (EG)
families.physicalMechanism: Program: Channel Hot Hole-Induced Electron Injection (CHEI); Erase: Electrons tunnel from floating gate edge to Erase Gate via localized FN tunneling
families.summary: Overcomes the cell-area scaling bottleneck of single-poly MTP caused by bulky capacitive couplers. Introduces a dedicated lateral Erase Gate (EG), enabling electrons to tunnel directly out of the floating gate edge to EG without requiring large coupling capacitors, slashing cell size to 25–40 F² and establishing the gold standard in automotive BCD, PMIC, and OLED/LCD display drivers (DDIC).

patents.title: Non-volatile memory cell with erase gate and method of operating the same
patents.coreProblem: How to achieve electrical erase in single-poly logic CMOS without large substrate coupling capacitors or double-poly stacks?
patents.mechanism: Positions a dedicated Erase Gate (EG, formed of an adjacent n+ diffusion or polysilicon node) next to the PMOS floating gate. Applying positive 10–12V pulses to EG generates strong localized fringing electric fields along the floating-gate edge, drawing electrons out via FN tunneling directly into EG.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 covers a memory cell comprising a PMOS storage transistor and a lateral erase gate, with the erase path entirely decoupled from the read channel.
patents.productLink: Foundational patent underpinning NeoMTP 16Kb–1Mb embedded code storage.

patents.title: High density single poly non-volatile memory cell array with edge erase mechanism
patents.coreProblem: How to organize erase gates within large arrays to avoid cross-disturb between wordlines and bitlines during sector erase?
patents.mechanism: Shares erase gate lines across adjacent rows or sectors combined with well reverse-biasing, enabling block/sector erase and page programming with array layout efficiency exceeding 70%.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 specifies shared erase gate interconnect topologies across cell rows and corresponding array decoding structures.
patents.productLink: The production array architecture for NeoMTP in automotive BCD and display drivers.

families.name: NeoPUF® Hardware Security & Root-of-Trust Patent Family
families.tagline: Oxide Quantum Tunneling Randomness · Zero Bit Error Rate (BER) · Differential Balanced Sensing · Chip DNA
families.cellTopology: Paired Antifuse Differential Cell + Auto-Tracking Differential Sense Amplifier
families.physicalMechanism: Exploits unpredictable atomic-scale thickness fluctuations and quantum tunneling probabilities in ultra-thin gate oxides; differential tracking architecture cancels PVT drifts
families.processNode: 55nm down to 2nm (Universal Across All CMOS, FinFET, and GAA Nodes)
families.summary: eMemory's epochal innovation expanding from memory storage into hardware cybersecurity. While legacy SRAM PUFs suffer from startup latency, aging degradation, and high bit-error rates (10–15% requiring heavy ECC), eMemory discovered that microscopic quantum tunneling through virgin ultra-thin gate oxides provides an ideal, lifelong stable random entropy source with zero bit flips, spawning subsidiary PUFsecurity and earning adoption across major secure processors.

patents.title: Physical unclonable function apparatus utilizing dielectric breakdown variation
patents.coreProblem: Conventional SRAM PUFs suffer bit flips across temperature variations, requiring extensive helper data and power-hungry ECC that enlarge chip area and invite side-channel attacks.
patents.mechanism: Applies identical initial electrical stress across a pair of nominally identical gate oxide capacitors. Because atomic oxygen vacancies and tunneling barrier widths vary randomly at the nanoscale, their tunneling currents exhibit intrinsic micro-differences. Differential sensing converts this difference into a permanent binary '0' or '1' with zero bit error rate (BER < 10⁻¹²).
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 specifies a PUF apparatus comprising paired dielectric antifuse elements, measuring microscopic tunneling current variations, and latching the differential outcome into unique hardware identities.
patents.productLink: Founding invention patent behind NeoPUF and PUFsecurity's PUFrt and PUFcc product families.

patents.title: PUF cell structure and differential reading circuit with tracking reference
patents.coreProblem: How to guarantee 100% key bit stability without a single bit flip under extreme -40°C to 150°C automotive temperatures and supply voltage sags?
patents.mechanism: Implements fully symmetrical common-mode differential sense amplifiers, ensuring PVT fluctuations affect paired cells identically as common-mode shifts, completely canceled at differential sensing nodes.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 covers differential balanced readout architectures, common-mode rejection circuits, and sensing methods maintaining bit consistency across full temperature ranges.
patents.productLink: Key circuit patent enabling PUFrt to achieve PSA Certified Level 3 and FIPS 140-3 evaluations.

patents.title: Random number generator utilizing quantum tunneling mechanism of dielectric layer
patents.coreProblem: True random number generators (TRNG) traditionally rely on thermal noise or ring oscillator jitter, vulnerable to external power injection or thermal manipulation attacks.
patents.mechanism: Harvests pure quantum shot noise generated during electron tunneling through dielectric barriers as an untamperable entropy source, passing the entire NIST SP 800-22 and FIPS 140-3 statistical test suites.
patents.claimFocus: Claim 1 claims an apparatus utilizing gate dielectric quantum tunneling shot noise as entropy source coupled with dynamic sampling circuits to output true random sequences.
patents.productLink: Embedded TRNG IP within PUFsecurity cryptographic co-processors.
